title: HUMMINGBIRDS: FROM NEST TO FLIGHT
caption: From a hummingbird nestling practicing wingbeats to adult Anna's hummingbirds at flowers: separate archival birds; the opening nestling's species is unverified. #AnnasHummingbird #Birds #Wildlife #WildVox Footage creators: Dennis.insect.filmer; Larry & Teddy Page; Danmation; Rishiraj Sahoo; Love Star Production; Mike's Birds. Original licenses: CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY 2.0, CC BY 3.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, CC0, CC BY-SA 2.0. Edits: excerpts, narration, subtitles, portrait framing. Adapted footage CC BY-SA 4.0 where required; source/credit/license details: github.com/lulualcides-sys/wildvox-automation/blob/main/qa/credits/2026-10-29.md

narration_timeline.text: This tiny hummingbird is beating its wings before it can even leave the nest.
narration_timeline.scene: Real nestling practicing wingbeats in the nest, no invented first flight.

narration_timeline.text: While it is still small, an adult returns to the nest with food as the chick grows stronger.
narration_timeline.scene: Adult Anna's hummingbird already visible feeding nestlings at source 5.5s; separate fledgling footage follows, not one continuous bird.

narration_timeline.text: Adult hummingbirds hover at flowers, while Anna's hummingbirds also pause on branches as they move through their territory.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic hummingbird hovering at red flower, followed by a separate Anna's hummingbird moving/perching in lemon tree; no same-individual claim.

narration_timeline.text: At feeders, rapid wingbeats bring them in, and they may perch to take a drink.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Anna's hummingbird at feeder, perched to drink; do not claim this shot shows hovering.

narration_timeline.text: Even in wet weather, they may sit and wait between feeding trips.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Anna's hummingbird perched during wet weather; no synthetic rain.

narration_timeline.text: From a tiny nestling to hummingbirds hovering at flowers, wing skills grow fast.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate archival juvenile Anna's hummingbird hovering at red flowers from Hummingbird.ogv; not the opening nestling.
